Integrity and signing scope

Reading copy · Signed evidence PDF

The signature makes alteration detectable. It does not prevent copying or editing, and it does not establish that a court has accepted the account.

What is signed

The PDF contains the account, selected timeline, 108 cited-line exhibits and the source-hash index. Its certification signature allows no changes. A separately signed release manifest identifies the website files and this final PDF. Preserved sources remain unchanged. The recording and original GIFs are public; complete transcript files remain in the private archive.

Verified during preparation

  • The PDF signature was cryptographically valid and covered the entire issued file.
  • A changed-byte copy failed the integrity check.
  • A copy with appended unsigned bytes failed the entire-file coverage check.
  • The 78 selected source files matched their preserved hashes.

Identity and legal scope

This is a self-issued local integrity key, not an independently identity-certified personal signature. It has no trusted timestamp and is not notarized or sworn testimony. Court acceptance has not been determined. The local signing time is not an independently attested time.

Adobe Reader may report the identity as unknown until the certificate is trusted. Compare its fingerprint with a copy received independently. Do not add a replacement certificate to trust merely because this website serves it.
